routes.title: Privacy Policy — Which Movie To Watch
routes.description: Which Movie To Watch stores your preferences on your own device, uses cookieless analytics, and never sells data. Read the full privacy policy.
routes.intro: Which Movie To Watch is built to know your taste in movies without knowing who you are. Your watch history, loved films, and preferences live in your own browser's storage — they never leave your device and we could not read them if we wanted to.
